judges.reason: The formula is not a principal disjunctive normal form because the second conjunction p∧q∧r omits variable s, so it is not a complete minterm. It is also not a principal conjunctive normal form, since the outer connective is disjunction rather than conjunction of complete maxterms. Thus [[B]] matches the canonical answer.
judges.depth_evidence: A direct structural check of the two required normal-form conditions suffices: every disjunct must contain all variables for principal DNF, and the formula must be a conjunction of complete maxterms for principal CNF.
judges.explanation_evidence: The supplied certificate identifies the missing variable s in the second disjunct and correctly notes that the whole formula is not a conjunction of complete maxterms. Its optional equivalence to minterms 12, 14, and 15 is also consistent with the formula.
